package sample

import (
	"database/sql/driver"
	"errors"
"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/auth/password"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/codec"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/temporal"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/value"
	"time"
)

//foundry:enum
type Direction string

const Forward Direction = "forward"

type Pair[A, B any] struct {
	First  A
	Second B
}

// found: model of an account
//foundry:model table=input_families var=InputFamilies key=ID identity=false
type InputFamily struct {
 Hash password.Hash `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asHash,codec=hashCodec"`
 MaybeHash value.Nullable[password.Hash] `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asHash,codec=hashCodec"`
	ID             int64
	Enabled        bool                                          `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBool"`
	MaybeEnabled   value.Nullable[bool]                          `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBool"`
	Label          string                                        `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asText" found:"exact" boundary:"unrelated" foundryui:"dropdown"`
	MaybeLabel     value.Nullable[string]                        `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asText"`
	Number         int                                           `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asNumber"`
	MaybeNumber    value.Nullable[int]                           `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asNumber"`
	At             time.Time                                     `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asTime"`
	MaybeAt        value.Nullable[time.Time]                     `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asTime"`
	Direction      Direction                                     `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asDirection"`
	MaybeDirection value.Nullable[Direction]                     `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asDirection"`
	Data           value.JSON[map[string]string]                 `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asJSON"`
	MaybeData      value.Nullable[value.JSON[map[string]string]] `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asJSON"`
	Interval       temporal.Interval                             `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asInterval"`
	MaybeInterval  value.Nullable[temporal.Interval]             `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asInterval"`
	Bytes          []byte                                        `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBytes"`
	MaybeBytes     value.Nullable[[]byte]                        `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBytes"`
	Generic        string                                        `foundry:"input=Pair[string,int],mutate=asPair"`
	Custom         [2]byte                                       `foundry:"codec=customCodec"`
}

func asBool(string) (bool, error)           { return false, nil }
func asText(s string) (string, error)       { return s, nil }
func asNumber(string) (int, error)          { return 0, nil }
func asTime(string) (time.Time, error)      { return time.Time{}, nil }
func asDirection(string) (Direction, error) { return Forward, nil }
func asJSON(string) (value.JSON[map[string]string], error) {
	return value.JSON[map[string]string]{}, nil
}
func asInterval(string) (temporal.Interval, error) { return temporal.Interval{}, nil }
func asBytes(s string) ([]byte, error)             { return []byte(s), nil }
func asPair(p Pair[string, int]) (string, error)   { return p.First, nil }
func customCodec() codec.Codec[[2]byte] {
	return codec.New(func(v [2]byte) (driver.Value, error) { return v[:], nil }, func(raw any) ([2]byte, error) {
		data, ok := raw.([]byte)
		if !ok || len(data) != 2 {
			return [2]byte{}, errors.New("expected two bytes")
		}
		return [2]byte(data), nil
	})
}

func asHash(string)(password.Hash,error){return password.Hash{},nil}
func hashCodec()codec.Codec[password.Hash]{return password.Codec()}
